prompt:
Create a 16-second vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic miniature farming time-lapse.

A completely barren miniature mountain slope is rapidly transformed by 50–100 tiny realistic farmers into spectacular multi-level rice terraces. Keep the entire video extremely fast-paced, dense, and continuously active, with multiple teams working simultaneously.

0–2s — MARKING & DIGGING
Farmers stretch ropes, hammer wooden stakes, measure levels, and immediately dig the dry mountain soil with hoes and shovels.

2–4s — TERRACE CONSTRUCTION
Multiple teams carve horizontal terraces simultaneously. Workers excavate soil, carry baskets downhill, level surfaces, and physically build stone retaining walls. Terraces must develop visibly—never appear instantly.

4–6s — IRRIGATION
Farmers stack stones, compact soil, dig connecting water channels, and place tiny wooden bridges. A water gate opens and muddy water physically flows from the highest terrace through the lower paddies.

6–8s — PADDIES & PLANTING
Farmers spread and level wet mud while others carry baskets of rice seedlings. Groups kneel, plant seedlings row-by-row, stand, and rapidly move to the next section.

8–10s — MASS PLANTING
Rapid time-lapse shows hundreds of seedlings being physically planted while other teams maintain irrigation channels and water levels. Terraces become dense green rice fields.

10–12s — GROWTH & MAINTENANCE
Rice naturally grows through accelerated time-lapse. Farmers weed, repair terrace walls, clear irrigation channels, and carry tools and baskets.

12–14s — HARVEST
Green rice rapidly becomes golden and ripe. Farmers use tiny sickles to cut stalks, bundle them, carry them in baskets, and load small wooden carts.

14–16s — FINAL REVEAL
Fast smooth camera pull-back and upward reveal of huge layered rice terraces, stone walls, flowing channels, muddy paths, bridges, golden fields, carts, baskets, and dozens of farmers still harvesting.

STYLE: Photorealistic macro miniature photography, detailed soil and stones, realistic muddy water, natural daylight, accurate shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle handheld macro movement, 8K-level detail. Real humans at miniature scale—not CGI, cartoon, animation, or plastic toys.

STRICT: No magical appearances, teleportation, disappearing objects, duplicated/morphing workers, floating workers, instant terraces, instant growth, changing layouts, giant humans, oversized tools, text, logos, or watermark. Every terrace, wall, channel, seedling, and harvest bundle must be physically constructed, planted, or handled.
